comparison.caveat: Failure-retaining ABBAAB campaign. Counts cover completed reported workloads only; partial failed attempts are unknown, not zero errors. No comparison delta for fewer than three complete runs per variant. Retry-affected latency excludes failed attempts; lifecycle goodput includes them. Shared-host evidence is not speed or audit clearance.

comparison_continuation.note: Retain initial failed baseline exactly once. Run remaining planned BB AAB processes with identical inputs, without retries or relaxed driver gates. Summaries validate only fully reported workloads; missing/failed workloads remain explicit failures, not zero-error samples.

upstream_contract.source_observation: Tokio-Rustls poll_write can accept plaintext while ciphertext remains pending. Its read path does not flush output. poll_flush drains pending ciphertext. Tokio TCP poll_flush is a no-op, not a Nagle override.

correctness: Initial full verification exits one after a protected HTTP3MCP test times out after30s;156core,140/148FFI,80driver and525router tests pass. Isolated test with correct ffi-test library passes without code/timeout changes. The first isolated command used production library and skipped due to missing hooks, not a real pass. Root cause of timeout is not established; high FD/memory or shared load alone would not prove it.

Fresh full bin/verify exits zero:156core,140defaultFFI,148test-hookFFI,29artifact,80driver tests;526router with one explicit skip;11remote-auth and13zero-copy cases;all package/liveMCP gates;6Chrome/Dart2Wasm SCRAM and2WebSocket tests. This passing rerun does not erase or establish the cause of the earlier HTTP3 timeout. No timeout or retry tolerance was relaxed.

No cipher, serializer, ABI, package version or production TLS configuration changes. One flush after buffered response bytes or terminal streaming chunk; no per-chunk flush. Failure propagates and streaming reader closes.

Seven tests use no global native state. Four real TLS1.3 cases force ciphertext backpressure using a 64-byte duplex and a generated trusted certificate. Helpers must return with no pending TLS ciphertext; exact response bytes and a second response after a peer marker prove stream reuse, not independently parsing an HTTP request. Real HTTP keepalive is additionally exercised by the driver and existing integration tests.

Initial fixture hit four handshake timeouts because post-handshake tickets could fill its tiny pipe before client application reads began. Test-only ticket disabling fixes setup; production tickets remain enabled. Confirmed before run has six assertion failures and one plain-wire control pass; after all seven pass.

The old-helper assertion on pending ciphertext closes its test server and causes client TLS EOF. This proves premature completion and truncation under forced closure, not independent reproduction of the production idle timer or every historical retry cause.

Chunked writer is generic AsyncWrite+Unpin only for a private test seam; production remains monomorphized to the existing IoWriteHalf. No dynamic dispatch or temporary diagnostic logging in the candidate.
Two separate synthetic flush-failure tests verify BrokenPipe propagation. poll_shutdown intentionally panics to detect accidental connection shutdown, not to simulate an I/O error.
local_review: Initial GLM debug output hit its token limit and is not a completed review; narrowed debug, test planning and Qwen review completed. Outputs are advisory and source/test checks remain authoritative.

Rejected unsupported review claims: flush does not implicitly invoke shutdown; reader.close closes the producer channel, not the socket; Tokio TCP flush is a no-op rather than a Nagle override. The tiny duplex is intentional backpressure and all focused tests pass. Do not weaken the shutdown sentinel or enlarge buffers to avoid exercising the failure.

Corrected test-planning errors: inspect the server TLS session, not the client, for pending response ciphertext. Chunk length for hello world is hexadecimal B, not 1. Exact fixture wire bytes are independently constructed and checked.

The initial collector review hit its output limit. A narrowed completed review found no concrete integrity defect. Its residual timeout/crash concerns describe deliberately incomplete evidence, never success; missing driver fields fail validation, and hashes prevent a changed driver from entering this campaign. This scratch collector is not a resumable production scheduler.
methodology: Six ABBAAB processes on one shared host, three per native library. Same frozen driver/AOT service/client, one router worker, four native runtime threads; binaries and scripts hashchecked before each run. Current source/hash and baseline checkpoint retained.

Each HTTP1/2/3 protocol has serial 2000x1, sustained 256x4 (256KiB up,1MiB down;64/128KiB chunks), and fresh 128x8 (1KiB each way) cases. Separate warmup sessions:16iterations/client per case. Planned72864 measured logical requests and3744warmups; actual counts only include completed JSONL workloads. Partial failed-workload attempts are unknown and are not zero-error evidence.

The first baseline process failed during HTTP1 streaming warmup. Original collector exited one and all its artifacts were retained. A separate continuation collector consumes that entry exactly once and runs remaining BB AAB with identical hashed scenario/driver/native inputs. Any driver failure remains a strict failure; only workload rows present in all six processes receive a balanced three-per-variant performance delta. Driver retries/timeouts and sample budgets were not relaxed.

Exact sample identities/counts, reported byte counts, finite latency and fresh setup+request<=operation-total checks. No independent HTTP content hash beyond the deterministic byte-verifying tests. Full errors and connection checks unchanged.

Unexpected reconnects are retained strict findings and cause nonzero collector exit even if only the baseline is affected. Terminal logical-request errors and server counters do not count recovered attempts. Request-only p99 excludes failed-attempt time; lifecycle goodput includes it, preventing direct clean-request latency claims on retry-affected rows.

GBit/s is application request+response bytes divided by lifecycle elapsed, not wire bandwidth. Warmups do not share sessions with measured cases. RSS after workloads is shared-process state and maxRSS is a high-water mark, not isolated per-case allocation. HTTP driver client memory is not measured.

No own tests/builds/inference overlap timed comparisons. Preflight waits and boundary CPU snapshots retained; they cannot guarantee no within-run unrelated contention or statistically prove zero overhead.

Prior bufferedJSONfile gate failure and earlier relative regressions remain open. No new absolute HTTP1 throughput threshold is invented and no WAMP/file/frame budget is weakened; unrelated paths were not re-benchmarked by this HTTP1-only correction.
remaining: Check long-lived HTTP1 streams while producer is paused mid-response; completion flush tests do not establish timely intermediate SSE delivery.

Reproduce the native HTTP1 exact Transfer-Encoding comparison lead with list/repeated transfer codings and CL+TE, including no-second-dispatch and valid controls, before claiming request smuggling or changing the parser. RFC9112 section6.3 supplies the framing contract.
Investigate any new remaining retry/performance findings and retain all previous checkpoint failures and shared-host caveats.
Finite resource-handle availability, core listener/connection boundaries, broader HTTP/FFI lifetime and all unreviewed component rows remain incomplete. No full audit or release clearance.

import importlib.util
import json
import statistics
import subprocess
import time
import tomllib
from pathlib import Path

HELPER = Path('/tmp/connectanum-sa008-resource-compare.py')
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('comparison_helpers', HELPER)
c = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(c)
c.OUT = Path('/tmp/connectanum-sa009-http-performance')
c.LIBRARIES = {
    'baseline': Path('/tmp/connectanum-sa008-resource-libct_ffi.dylib'),
    'patched': Path('/tmp/connectanum-sa009-h1-flush-libct_ffi.dylib'),
}
c.EXPECTED = {
    c.DRIVER: 'a8d92bc35e6c4fa8dfb8075d7a17b7c8dcc959fb5fb164673029f3ea991e03e1',
    c.SERVICE: '171ce6f5e1091556fe30a2c6a55b97af83e600155754a3398aecfb52649c5b85',
    c.WORKER: 'c79ed4e83c293e727a81b78bbcc2d4628311aeaeb3e1ba2d4e31b4213addd074',
    c.LIBRARIES['baseline']: '2ca93e7991c50b396e37fc4e60f75fcbcbdca9f5328a1c78d7e2ae8bd176701c',
    c.LIBRARIES['patched']: '88f8245b18a16d22a3d9756c18519f08fdd55d4e32f3d39ce9290983052b521b',
}


def main():
    c.OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    cases = [case for case in c.scenario_cases() if case['protocol'] in ['h1', 'h2', 'h3']]
    assert len(cases) == 9
    scenario = c.OUT / 'http1_response_flush.toml'
    with scenario.open('x') as out:
        out.write('name = "http1_response_flush"\ndescription = "Native-only response-boundary flush comparison; unchanged driver, payloads, TLS and AOT consumers."\n')
        for case in cases:
            for warmup in [True, False]:
                values = dict(case)
                if warmup:
                    values.update(name='warmup_' + case['name'], iterations=c.warmup_iterations(case))
                out.write('\n[[workloads]]\n')
                for key, value in values.items():
                    out.write(f'{key} = {json.dumps(value)}\n')
    assert len(tomllib.loads(scenario.read_text())['workloads']) == 18
    identity = {str(p): c.digest(p) for p in [*c.EXPECTED, c.LAUNCHER, scenario, HELPER, Path(__file__)]}
    assert all(identity[str(p)] == expected for p, expected in c.EXPECTED.items())
    source_paths = ['native/transport/ct_core/src/lib.rs', 'native/transport/ct_core/src/protocol.rs',
                    'native/transport/ct_core/src/http1_response_tests.rs']
    c.write_new(c.OUT / 'inputs.json', dict(
        hashes=identity, baseline_source='e2588461', cases=cases,
        source_hashes={p: c.digest(c.ROOT / p) for p in source_paths},
        native_diff=subprocess.check_output(['git', 'diff', '--', *source_paths], cwd=c.ROOT, text=True),
        test_source=(c.ROOT / source_paths[-1]).read_text(),
        note='Baseline is frozen SA-008 production library; candidate adds only HTTP/1 response-boundary flushes and a generic private writer test seam. Full driver/AOT identity unchanged; no cipher, version, workload, retry or performance threshold changes.',
        platform=subprocess.check_output(['uname', '-a'], text=True).strip(),
    ))
    runs = []
    for i, variant in enumerate(['baseline', 'patched', 'patched', 'baseline', 'baseline', 'patched'], 1):
        name = f'{i:02}-{variant}'
        c.preflight(name)
        assert all(c.digest(Path(p)) == sha for p, sha in identity.items())
        result = c.OUT / f'{name}.jsonl'
        command = [str(c.DRIVER), '--dart', str(c.LAUNCHER), '--bench-main', str(c.SERVICE),
                   '--wamp-worker-executable', str(c.WORKER), '--native-lib', str(c.LIBRARIES[variant]),
                   '--scenario', str(scenario), '--router-worker-counts', '1',
                   '--native-runtime-thread-counts', '4', '--results', str(result),
                   '--artifact-dir', str(c.OUT / name)]
        entry = dict(variant=variant, command=command, cpu_before=c.cpu(), started_at=time.time())
        c.write_new(c.OUT / f'{name}.started.json', entry)
        print(f'Starting {name}', flush=True)
        try:
            with (c.OUT / f'{name}.log').open('x') as log:
                run = subprocess.run(command, cwd=c.ROOT, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=1200)
            entry['return_code'] = run.returncode
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            entry.update(return_code=None, timeout_seconds=1200)
            raise
        finally:
            entry.update(cpu_after=c.cpu(), finished_at=time.time())
            c.write_new(c.OUT / f'{name}.finished.json', entry)
        run.check_returncode()
        entry.update(workloads=c.summarize(result, cases), raw_sha256=c.digest(result), log_sha256=c.digest(c.OUT / f'{name}.log'))
        entry['validation_findings'] = [f for w in entry['workloads'] for f in w.get('validation_findings', [])]
        entry['strict_validation_passed'] = not entry['validation_findings']
        c.write_new(c.OUT / f'{name}.summary.json', entry)
        runs.append(entry)
        print(f'Collected {name}: {len(entry["workloads"])} workloads; {len(entry["validation_findings"])} strict findings', flush=True)
        time.sleep(3)
    comparison = {}
    for case in cases:
        name = case['name']
        item = {}
        for variant in c.LIBRARIES:
            rows = [w for r in runs if r['variant'] == variant for w in r['workloads'] if w['workload'] == name]
            fields = ['requests_per_second', 'gbit_per_second', 'p50_ms', 'p95_ms', 'p99_ms']
            if not case['reuse_connections']:
                fields.append('operation_total_p99_ms')
            item[variant] = {key: dict(median=statistics.median(w[key] for w in rows), min=min(w[key] for w in rows), max=max(w[key] for w in rows)) for key in fields}
            for field in ['current_rss_bytes', 'max_rss_bytes']:
                values = [w['server_process'][field] / 1048576 for w in rows]
                item[variant][field.replace('_bytes', '_mib')] = dict(median=statistics.median(values), min=min(values), max=max(values))
        item['throughput_delta_percent'] = 100 * (item['patched']['gbit_per_second']['median'] / item['baseline']['gbit_per_second']['median'] - 1)
        comparison[name] = item
    findings = [dict(run=i + 1, variant=r['variant'], **f) for i, r in enumerate(runs) for f in r['validation_findings']]
    measured = sum(w['samples'] for r in runs for w in r['workloads'] if not w['workload'].startswith('warmup_'))
    warmups = sum(w['samples'] for r in runs for w in r['workloads'] if w['workload'].startswith('warmup_'))
    assert measured == 72864 and warmups == 3744
    c.write_new(c.OUT / 'comparison.json', dict(runs=runs, comparison=comparison,
        measured_operations=measured, warmup_operations=warmups,
        strict_validation_passed=not findings, validation_findings=findings,
        caveat='All runs retained; recovered requests are not error-free transport. Request p99 omits failed attempts; lifecycle goodput includes them. Baseline retries prevent clean-request speed claims. Shared-host RSS after each workload is not isolated peak memory. Warmups use separate sessions. No zero-overhead or full-audit clearance implied.'))
    if findings:
        print(f'Strict comparison failed: {len(findings)} connection findings; all six runs retained.', flush=True)
        raise SystemExit(1)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

import importlib.util
import json
import math
import statistics
import subprocess
import time
from pathlib import Path

spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('original', '/tmp/connectanum-sa009-http-compare.py')
original = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(original)
c = original.c
inputs = json.loads((c.OUT / 'inputs.json').read_text())
cases = inputs['cases']
scenario = c.OUT / 'http1_response_flush.toml'
expected_order = [name for case in cases for name in ['warmup_' + case['name'], case['name']]]


def summarize_partial(path, complete):
    rows = [json.loads(line) for line in path.read_text().splitlines()]
    assert [row['workload'] for row in rows] == expected_order[:len(rows)]
    if complete:
        assert len(rows) == len(expected_order)
    summaries = []
    for row in rows:
        name = row['workload']
        case = next(case for case in cases if case['name'] == name.removeprefix('warmup_'))
        samples = row['samples']
        iterations = c.warmup_iterations(case) if name.startswith('warmup_') else case['iterations']
        assert row['iterations'] == iterations and row['concurrency'] == case['concurrency']
        assert len(samples) == iterations * case['concurrency']
        assert {(s['worker'], s['iteration']) for s in samples} == {(w, i) for w in range(case['concurrency']) for i in range(iterations)}
        assert not any(sample.get('error') for sample in samples)
        assert all(s['request_bytes'] == case['request_bytes'] and s['response_bytes'] == case['response_bytes'] for s in samples)
        latencies = sorted(s['latency_ms'] for s in samples)
        assert all(math.isfinite(v) and v >= 0 for v in latencies)
        elapsed = (row['completed_at_ms'] - row['started_at_ms']) / 1000
        assert math.isfinite(elapsed) and elapsed > 0
        usage = row['http_connection_usage']
        assert usage['reuse_connections'] == case['reuse_connections']
        expected = case['concurrency'] if case['reuse_connections'] else len(samples)
        findings = [] if usage['connections_opened'] == expected else [dict(workload=name, expected_connections=expected, connections_opened=usage['connections_opened'])]
        after = row['metrics_after']['metrics']['transport']
        before = row['metrics_before']['metrics']['transport']
        counters = {k: v - before.get(k, 0) for k, v in after.items() if isinstance(v, (int, float))}
        for key in ['protocol_error_events', 'internal_error_events', 'body_timeout_events', 'idle_timeout_events']:
            assert counters.get(key, 0) == 0, (name, key, counters)
        summary = dict(workload=name, samples=len(samples), errors=0,
            lifecycle_seconds=elapsed, requests_per_second=len(samples) / elapsed,
            gbit_per_second=len(samples) * (case['request_bytes'] + case['response_bytes']) * 8 / elapsed / 1e9,
            p50_ms=statistics.median(latencies), p95_ms=latencies[int((len(latencies)-1)*.95)], p99_ms=latencies[int((len(latencies)-1)*.99)],
            server_process=row['metrics_after']['metrics']['process'], client_process=row.get('client_process_metrics'),
            transport_counter_deltas=counters, connection_usage=usage, validation_findings=findings)
        if not case['reuse_connections']:
            for sample in samples:
                timing = sample['http_fresh_connection_timing']
                assert all(math.isfinite(v) and v >= 0 for v in timing.values())
                assert timing['operation_total_ms'] + 1e-6 >= timing['connection_setup_ms'] + sample['latency_ms']
            total = sorted(s['http_fresh_connection_timing']['operation_total_ms'] for s in samples)
            summary['operation_total_p99_ms'] = total[int((len(total)-1)*.99)]
        summaries.append(summary)
    return summaries


def collect(name, entry):
    entry.update(workloads=summarize_partial(c.OUT / f'{name}.jsonl', entry['return_code'] == 0),
                 raw_sha256=c.digest(c.OUT / f'{name}.jsonl'), log_sha256=c.digest(c.OUT / f'{name}.log'))
    entry['validation_findings'] = [f for w in entry['workloads'] for f in w['validation_findings']]
    if entry['return_code'] != 0:
        entry['validation_findings'].append(dict(driver_exit_code=entry['return_code'],
            next_unreported_workload=expected_order[len(entry['workloads'])] if len(entry['workloads']) < len(expected_order) else None,
            detail='Process failed; incomplete workload attempts are not represented by completed JSONL rows. Do not count them as zero errors.'))
    entry['strict_validation_passed'] = not entry['validation_findings']
    c.write_new(c.OUT / f'{name}.summary.json', entry)
    print(f'Collected {name}: {len(entry["workloads"])} completed workloads; {len(entry["validation_findings"])} strict findings', flush=True)
    return entry


def main():
    assert all(c.digest(Path(path)) == sha for path, sha in inputs['hashes'].items())
    assert all(c.digest(c.ROOT / path) == sha for path, sha in inputs['source_hashes'].items())
    first = json.loads((c.OUT / '01-baseline.finished.json').read_text())
    assert first['variant'] == 'baseline' and first['return_code'] == 1
    assert not any((c.OUT / f'{i:02}-{v}.started.json').exists() for i, v in enumerate(['baseline', 'patched', 'patched', 'baseline', 'baseline', 'patched'], 1) if i > 1)
    c.write_new(c.OUT / 'continuation.json', dict(script=str(Path(__file__)), sha256=c.digest(Path(__file__)),
        note='Retain initial failed baseline exactly once. Run remaining planned BB AAB processes with identical inputs, without retries or relaxed driver gates. Summaries validate only fully reported workloads; missing/failed workloads remain explicit failures, not zero-error samples.'))
    runs = [collect('01-baseline', first)]
    for i, variant in enumerate(['patched', 'patched', 'baseline', 'baseline', 'patched'], 2):
        name = f'{i:02}-{variant}'
        c.preflight(name)
        assert all(c.digest(Path(p)) == sha for p, sha in inputs['hashes'].items())
        command = [str(c.DRIVER), '--dart', str(c.LAUNCHER), '--bench-main', str(c.SERVICE),
                   '--wamp-worker-executable', str(c.WORKER), '--native-lib', str(c.LIBRARIES[variant]),
                   '--scenario', str(scenario), '--router-worker-counts', '1',
                   '--native-runtime-thread-counts', '4', '--results', str(c.OUT / f'{name}.jsonl'),
                   '--artifact-dir', str(c.OUT / name)]
        entry = dict(variant=variant, command=command, cpu_before=c.cpu(), started_at=time.time())
        c.write_new(c.OUT / f'{name}.started.json', entry)
        print(f'Starting {name}', flush=True)
        try:
            with (c.OUT / f'{name}.log').open('x') as log:
                run = subprocess.run(command, cwd=c.ROOT, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=1200)
            entry['return_code'] = run.returncode
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            entry.update(return_code=None, timeout_seconds=1200)
            raise
        finally:
            entry.update(cpu_after=c.cpu(), finished_at=time.time())
            c.write_new(c.OUT / f'{name}.finished.json', entry)
        runs.append(collect(name, entry))
        time.sleep(3)
    comparison = {}
    for case in cases:
        item = {}
        for variant in c.LIBRARIES:
            rows = [w for r in runs if r['variant'] == variant for w in r['workloads'] if w['workload'] == case['name']]
            item[variant] = dict(completed_runs=len(rows))
            fields = ['requests_per_second', 'gbit_per_second', 'p50_ms', 'p95_ms', 'p99_ms']
            if not case['reuse_connections']:
                fields.append('operation_total_p99_ms')
            for field in fields:
                item[variant][field] = None if not rows else dict(median=statistics.median(w[field] for w in rows), min=min(w[field] for w in rows), max=max(w[field] for w in rows))
            for field in ['current_rss_bytes', 'max_rss_bytes']:
                values = [w['server_process'][field] / 1048576 for w in rows]
                item[variant][field.replace('_bytes', '_mib')] = None if not rows else dict(median=statistics.median(values), min=min(values), max=max(values))
        balanced = all(item[v]['completed_runs'] == 3 for v in c.LIBRARIES)
        item['complete_three_per_variant'] = balanced
        item['throughput_delta_percent'] = 100 * (item['patched']['gbit_per_second']['median'] / item['baseline']['gbit_per_second']['median'] - 1) if balanced else None
        comparison[case['name']] = item
    findings = [dict(run=i + 1, variant=r['variant'], **f) for i, r in enumerate(runs) for f in r['validation_findings']]
    measured = sum(w['samples'] for r in runs for w in r['workloads'] if not w['workload'].startswith('warmup_'))
    warmups = sum(w['samples'] for r in runs for w in r['workloads'] if w['workload'].startswith('warmup_'))
    assert measured <= 72864 and warmups <= 3744
    c.write_new(c.OUT / 'comparison.json', dict(runs=runs, comparison=comparison,
        planned_measured_operations=72864, planned_warmup_operations=3744,
        measured_operations=measured, warmup_operations=warmups,
        strict_validation_passed=not findings, validation_findings=findings,
        caveat='Failure-retaining ABBAAB campaign. Counts cover completed reported workloads only; partial failed attempts are unknown, not zero errors. No comparison delta for fewer than three complete runs per variant. Retry-affected latency excludes failed attempts; lifecycle goodput includes them. Shared-host evidence is not speed or audit clearance.'))
    raise SystemExit(1 if findings else 0)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

def digest(path):
    with path.open('rb') as stream:
        return hashlib.file_digest(stream, 'sha256').hexdigest()


def write_new(path, value):
    with path.open('x') as stream:
        json.dump(value, stream, indent=2)
        stream.write('\n')


def cpu():
    totals = dict(inference=0., virtual_machine=0., emulator=0., other=0.)
    for row in subprocess.check_output(['ps', '-axo', '%cpu,comm'], text=True).splitlines()[1:]:
        number, command = row.strip().split(maxsplit=1)
        key = ('inference' if 'llama-server' in command or 'ollama' in command else
               'virtual_machine' if 'Virtualization.framework' in command else
               'emulator' if 'qemu-system' in command else 'other')
        totals[key] += float(number)
    return {k: round(v, 1) for k, v in totals.items()}


def preflight(name):
    snapshots = []
    for _ in range(31):
        snapshot = dict(timestamp=time.time(), cpu=cpu())
        snapshots.append(snapshot)
        c = snapshot['cpu']
        if c['inference'] < 50 and c['virtual_machine'] < 600 and c['other'] < 800:
            write_new(OUT / f'{name}.preflight.json', snapshots)
            return
        time.sleep(10)
    write_new(OUT / f'{name}.preflight.json', snapshots)
    raise RuntimeError('Host remains busy; stop between benchmark processes')

    e2ee = tomllib.loads((ROOT / 'native/bench/scenarios/wamp_e2ee_throughput.toml').read_text())['workloads']
    assert len(e2ee) == 16
    for case in e2ee:
        # Pure-Dart AES has a much slower existing CPU path than native E2EE.
        # Fix sample budgets before either variant runs; retain every sample.
        case['iterations'] = (16 if case['client_impl'] == 'dart' and case['ppt_cipher'] == 'aes256gcm'
                              else 128 if case['client_impl'] == 'dart' else 256)
    files = tomllib.loads((ROOT / 'native/bench/scenarios/wamp_file_transfer_throughput.toml').read_text())['workloads']
    selected = [
        'rawsocket_file_msgpack_64m_native',
        'rawsocket_tls_file_cbor_64m_native_segmented',
        'websocket_file_cbor_64m_native_segmented',
        'rawsocket_file_cbor_e2ee_64m_native_segmented',
        'websocket_tls_file_cbor_e2ee_64m_native_segmented',
    ]
    cases = e2ee + [next(c for c in files if c['name'] == n).copy() for n in selected]
    for case in list(cases):
        if 'file_transfer' in case['protocol'] and case.get('ppt_cipher') == 'aes256gcm':
            cases.append(dict(case, name=case['name'] + '_xsalsa', ppt_cipher='xsalsa20poly1305'))
    assert len(cases) == 23
    for protocol in ['h1', 'h2', 'h3']:
        for mode, iterations, concurrency, request, response in [
                ('serial', 2000, 1, 1024, 1024),
                ('streaming', 256, 4, 262144, 1048576),
                ('fresh', 128, 8, 1024, 1024)]:
            case = dict(name=f'{protocol}_{mode}', protocol=protocol,
                        path='/bench/stream', method='POST', iterations=iterations,
                        concurrency=concurrency, request_bytes=request,
                        response_bytes=response, request_chunk_bytes=min(request, 65536),
                        response_chunk_bytes=min(response, 131072),
                        reuse_connections=mode != 'fresh')
            if protocol != 'h1':
                case['streams_per_connection'] = 4 if mode == 'streaming' else 1
            cases.append(case)
    assert len(cases) == 32

    return 4 if case['iterations'] == 16 else 16

    summaries = []
    for line in path.read_text().splitlines():
        row = json.loads(line)
        name = row['workload']
        case = next(c for c in cases if c['name'] == name.removeprefix('warmup_'))
        samples = row['samples']
        warmup = name.startswith('warmup_')
        iterations = warmup_iterations(case) if warmup else case['iterations']
        assert row['iterations'] == iterations and row['concurrency'] == case['concurrency']
        assert len(samples) == iterations * case['concurrency']
        assert len({(s['worker'], s['iteration']) for s in samples}) == len(samples)
        assert not any(s.get('error') for s in samples)
        http = case['protocol'] in ['h1', 'h2', 'h3']
        response = (case['response_bytes'] if http else
                    0 if 'file_transfer' in case['protocol'] else
                    case['request_bytes'] * case.get('peer_count', 1))
        assert all(s['request_bytes'] == case['request_bytes'] and s['response_bytes'] == response for s in samples)
        latency = sorted(s['latency_ms'] for s in samples)
        assert all(math.isfinite(value) and value >= 0 for value in latency)
        lifecycle = (row['completed_at_ms'] - row['started_at_ms']) / 1000
        elapsed = lifecycle if http else row['data_window_elapsed_ms'] / 1000
        if http:
            usage = row['http_connection_usage']
            assert usage['reuse_connections'] == case['reuse_connections']
            expected_connections = case['concurrency'] if case['reuse_connections'] else len(samples)
            connection_finding = (None if usage['connections_opened'] == expected_connections else
                                  dict(workload=name, expected_connections=expected_connections,
                                       connections_opened=usage['connections_opened']))
            if not case['reuse_connections']:
                for sample in samples:
                    timing = sample['http_fresh_connection_timing']
                    assert all(math.isfinite(v) and v >= 0 for v in timing.values())
                    assert timing['operation_total_ms'] + 1e-6 >= timing['connection_setup_ms'] + sample['latency_ms']
        assert elapsed > 0 and lifecycle > 0
        after = row['metrics_after']['metrics']['transport']
        before = row['metrics_before']['metrics']['transport']
        counters = {k: v - before.get(k, 0) for k, v in after.items() if isinstance(v, (int, float))}
        for key in ['protocol_error_events', 'internal_error_events', 'body_timeout_events', 'idle_timeout_events']:
            assert counters.get(key, 0) == 0, (name, key, counters)
        summaries.append(dict(
            workload=name, samples=len(samples), errors=0, data_seconds=elapsed,
            lifecycle_seconds=lifecycle, request_bytes=sum(s['request_bytes'] for s in samples),
            response_bytes=sum(s['response_bytes'] for s in samples),
            requests_per_second=len(samples) / elapsed,
            gbit_per_second=len(samples) * (case['request_bytes'] + response) * 8 / elapsed / 1e9,
            lifecycle_gbit_per_second=len(samples) * (case['request_bytes'] + response) * 8 / lifecycle / 1e9,
            p50_ms=statistics.median(latency), p95_ms=latency[int((len(latency)-1)*.95)],
            p99_ms=latency[int((len(latency)-1)*.99)],
            server_process=row['metrics_after']['metrics']['process'],
            client_process=row.get('client_process_metrics'), transport_counter_deltas=counters,
        ))
        summaries[-1]['throughput_window'] = 'HTTP lifecycle' if http else 'WAMP data window'
        if http:
            summaries[-1]['connection_usage'] = row['http_connection_usage']
            summaries[-1]['validation_findings'] = [] if connection_finding is None else [connection_finding]
            if not case['reuse_connections']:
                total = sorted(s['http_fresh_connection_timing']['operation_total_ms'] for s in samples)
                summaries[-1]['operation_total_p99_ms'] = total[int((len(total)-1)*.99)]
    assert len(summaries) == 2 * len(cases)
    assert len({w['workload'] for w in summaries}) == len(summaries)
    return summaries


def main():
    OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    cases = scenario_cases()
    scenario = OUT / 'resource_boundary.toml'
    with scenario.open('x') as stream:
        stream.write('name = "resource_boundary"\ndescription = "Native-only checked resource allocation comparison; unchanged AOT clients/router and cryptography."\n')
        for case in cases:
            for warmup in [True, False]:
                values = dict(case)
                if warmup:
                    values['name'] = 'warmup_' + case['name']
                    values['iterations'] = warmup_iterations(case)
                stream.write('\n[[workloads]]\n')
                for key, value in values.items():
                    stream.write(f'{key} = {json.dumps(value)}\n')
    assert tomllib.loads(scenario.read_text())['workloads']
    identity = {str(p): digest(p) for p in [*EXPECTED, LAUNCHER, scenario, Path(__file__)]}
    assert all(identity[str(p)] == expected for p, expected in EXPECTED.items())
    write_new(OUT / 'inputs.json', dict(
        hashes=identity, cases=cases, baseline_source='d1873a46',
        baseline_library_note='Frozen SA-007 native library, identical production sources to d1873a46.',
        native_diff=subprocess.check_output(['git', 'diff', '--', 'native/transport/ct_ffi/src/runtime/state.rs', 'native/transport/ct_ffi/src/runtime/ffi.rs'], cwd=ROOT, text=True),
        driver_diff=subprocess.check_output(['git', 'diff', '--', 'native/bench/src/bin/http_stream.rs'], cwd=ROOT, text=True),
        driver_note='Both variants use the same corrected HTTP/1 sender-readiness driver. Two earlier old-driver baseline attempts rejected reconnects and are retained separately.',
        allocator_source=(ROOT / 'native/transport/ct_ffi/src/runtime/resource_handles.rs').read_text(),
        candidate_source_hashes={p: digest(ROOT / p) for p in [
            'native/transport/ct_ffi/src/runtime/resource_handles.rs',
            'native/transport/ct_ffi/src/runtime/state.rs',
            'native/transport/ct_ffi/src/runtime/ffi.rs']},
        platform=subprocess.check_output(['uname', '-a'], text=True).strip(),
        toolchain_observed_now={
            'rustc': subprocess.check_output(['rustc', '-Vv'], text=True).strip(),
            'dart': subprocess.check_output(['dart', '--version'], text=True, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT).strip(),
            'note': 'Current local toolchain; frozen AOT service/worker hashes identify retained prior-checkpoint build inputs, not a rebuild during these timings.',
        },
    ))
    runs = []
    for i, variant in enumerate(['baseline', 'patched', 'patched', 'baseline', 'baseline', 'patched'], 1):
        name = f'{i:02}-{variant}'
        preflight(name)
        assert all(digest(Path(p)) == sha for p, sha in identity.items())
        result = OUT / f'{name}.jsonl'
        command = [str(DRIVER), '--dart', str(LAUNCHER), '--bench-main', str(SERVICE),
                   '--wamp-worker-executable', str(WORKER), '--native-lib', str(LIBRARIES[variant]),
                   '--scenario', str(scenario), '--router-worker-counts', '1',
                   '--native-runtime-thread-counts', '4', '--results', str(result),
                   '--artifact-dir', str(OUT / name)]
        entry = dict(variant=variant, command=command, cpu_before=cpu(), started_at=time.time())
        write_new(OUT / f'{name}.started.json', entry)
        print(f'Starting {name}', flush=True)
        try:
            with (OUT / f'{name}.log').open('x') as log:
                run = subprocess.run(command, cwd=ROOT, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=1200)
            entry.update(return_code=run.returncode)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            entry.update(return_code=None, timeout_seconds=1200)
            raise
        finally:
            entry.update(cpu_after=cpu(), finished_at=time.time())
            write_new(OUT / f'{name}.finished.json', entry)
        run.check_returncode()
        entry.update(workloads=summarize(result, cases), raw_sha256=digest(result))
        entry['validation_findings'] = [f for w in entry['workloads'] for f in w.get('validation_findings', [])]
        entry['strict_validation_passed'] = not entry['validation_findings']
        write_new(OUT / f'{name}.summary.json', entry)
        runs.append(entry)
        print(f'Collected {name}: {len(entry["workloads"])} workloads; {len(entry["validation_findings"])} strict findings', flush=True)
        time.sleep(3)
    comparison = {}
    for case in cases:
        name = case['name']
        item = {}
        for variant in LIBRARIES:
            rows = [w for r in runs if r['variant'] == variant for w in r['workloads'] if w['workload'] == name]
            item[variant] = {k: dict(median=statistics.median(w[k] for w in rows),
                                    min=min(w[k] for w in rows), max=max(w[k] for w in rows))
                             for k in ['requests_per_second', 'gbit_per_second', 'lifecycle_gbit_per_second', 'p50_ms', 'p95_ms', 'p99_ms']}
        if case['protocol'] in ['h1', 'h2', 'h3'] and not case['reuse_connections']:
            for variant in LIBRARIES:
                values = [w['operation_total_p99_ms'] for r in runs if r['variant'] == variant
                          for w in r['workloads'] if w['workload'] == name]
                item[variant]['operation_total_p99_ms'] = dict(median=statistics.median(values), min=min(values), max=max(values))
        item['throughput_delta_percent'] = 100 * (item['patched']['gbit_per_second']['median'] / item['baseline']['gbit_per_second']['median'] - 1)
        comparison[name] = item
    findings = [dict(run=i+1, variant=r['variant'], **f) for i, r in enumerate(runs) for f in r['validation_findings']]
    write_new(OUT / 'comparison.json', dict(runs=runs, comparison=comparison,
        strict_validation_passed=not findings, validation_findings=findings,
        caveat='Shared-host observation, not proof of zero overhead. GBit/s is application request plus response bytes, not wire bytes. Files count one-way payload only. Separate warmup workloads do not share sessions with measured workloads. HTTP throughput uses lifecycle elapsed; request latency excludes setup, with setup-inclusive p99 also recorded for fresh connections.'))
    if findings:
        print(f'Strict comparison failed: {len(findings)} unexpected connection counts; all processes retained.', flush=True)
        raise SystemExit(1)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
